paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the gradient norm of a reward model over a series of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step", uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 7000 with tick marks every 1000 units. The y-axis is labeled "Gradient Norm", also uses a linear scale, and spans values from 5 to 40 with tick marks every 5 units. The plot features a single line that is blue, with no markers, and a solid line style. The gradient norm starts at a value slightly below 40 at the beginning of the training steps, decreasing sharply to approximately 5 before the 1000-step mark. Beyond this point, the line exhibits fluctuations around a value of 5, with occasional spikes reaching up to around 10, observed at various points such as around 3000, 4000, and 6000 training steps. There is a legend at the top right of the plot to label the line.
